title: Zedekiah
lead: The last king of Judah (597-586 BC). Nebuchadnezzar made Mattaniah, a son of Josiah, king in place of his nephew Jehoiachin and changed his name to Zedekiah ('the LORD is righteous'). He reigned eleven years, rebelled against Babylon, and saw Jerusalem fall, his sons killed and his eyes put out (2 Kings 24:17-25:7; Jeremiah 52:1-11). Jeremiah advised him to submit, met him in secret during the siege, and promised he could live if he did (Jeremiah 37-38).
